data.text: The words of King Lemuel, the oracle unto which his mother disciplined him:
What, O my son? And what, O son of my womb? And what, O son of my vows?
Do not give your excellence to women, Or your ways to that which blots out kings.
It is not for kings, O Lemuel, It is not for kings to drink wine, Or for rulers to desire strong drink,
Lest he drink and forget what is decreed, And pervert the justice of all the afflicted.
Give strong drink to him who is perishing, And wine to those whose soul is bitter.
Let him drink and forget his poverty And he will not remember his trouble any longer.
Open your mouth for the mute, For the justice of all those passing away.
Open your mouth, judge righteously, And render justice to the afflicted and needy.
א  Aleph An excellent wife, who can find? For her worth is far above pearls.
ב  Beth The heart of her husband trusts in her, And he will have no lack of gain.
ג  Gimel She deals bountifully with him for good and not evil All the days of her life.
ד  Daleth She searches for wool and flax And works with her hands in delight.
ה  He She is like merchant ships; She brings her food from afar.
ו  Vav And she rises while it is still night, And gives food to her household And a portion to her young women.
ז  Zayin She makes plans for a field and buys it; From the fruit of her hands she plants a vineyard.
ח  Heth She girds herself with strength And makes her arms strong.
ט  Teth She senses that her gain is good; Her lamp does not go out at night.
י  Yodh She stretches out her hands to the distaff, And her hands hold fast the spindle.
כ  Kaph She extends her hand to the poor, And she stretches out her hands to the needy.
ל  Lamedh She is not afraid of the snow for her household, For all her household are clothed with scarlet.
מ  Mem She makes coverings for herself; Her clothing is fine linen and purple.
נ  Nun Her husband is known in the gates, When he sits with the elders of the land.
ס  Samekh She makes linen garments and sells them, And gives belts to the tradesmen.
ע  Ayin Strength and majesty are her clothing, And she smiles at the future.
פ  Pe She opens her mouth in wisdom, And the instruction of lovingkindness is on her tongue.
צ  Tsadhe She watches over the ways of her household, And does not eat the bread of idleness.
ק  Qoph Her children rise up and bless her; As for her husband, he also praises her, saying :
ר  Resh “Many daughters have done excellently, But you have gone above them all.”
שׁ  Shin Charm is deceitful and beauty is vain, But a woman who fears Yahweh, she shall be praised.
ת  Tav Give to her from the fruit of her hands, And let her works praise her in the gates.
